The *Kusaṭṭhakadāyakattheraapadāna* is a verse narrative located within the *Therāpadāna* collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. Like other texts in this genre, the poem recounts the past meritorious offering of an elder—here an offering associated with *kusa* grass (*kusaṭṭhaka*)—and the resulting sequence of heavenly rebirths culminating in the attainment of arahantship [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records translations of the text in five languages, but identifies no curated parallels in non-Pali traditions [SuttaCentral].

Text-reuse analysis reflects the highly formulaic character typical of Apadāna verse compositions [DharmaNexus].
